ruleControlIntro: 统一管理域名过滤、URL 规则及规则覆写的总控开关、拦截策略与在线规则订阅。黑名单、白名单与覆写名单可在功能中心中独立管理。

One place for the master switches of domain filtering, URL rules and rule overrides, the block policy and online rule subscriptions. Block, allow and override lists are still managed separately in the hub.
ruleControlDomainRulesOn: 开启 DNS 阶段域名屏蔽、白名单放行及 IPv4/IPv6 覆写
Blocks, allows and overrides IPv4/IPv6 at the DNS stage

DNS domain filtering is off; every query is passed through

blockResponseFixedFooter: 动态策略开启时会临时覆盖以上选择：先返回 NODATA，高频请求后返回 NXDOMAIN。
While the dynamic policy is on it overrides the choice above: NODATA first, then NXDOMAIN for frequent requests.
blockResponseEnableDynamicSubtitle: 同一域名的所有记录类型合并计数
All record types of a domain share one counter

blockResponseParamsSummary.zh: {threshold} 次 / {window} 秒 / 保持 {duration} 秒

blockResponseDynamicFooter: 正常客户端会缓存 NODATA 响应。动态策略主要用于持续重试或忽略负缓存的请求。
Well-behaved clients cache the NODATA answer. The dynamic policy mainly targets clients that keep retrying or ignore negative caching.

60–3600 seconds; timed from the first upgrade

Stored in https_bypass_rules and merged with the built-in list in assets/https_passthrough.txt for the engine's setExtraPassthroughSuffixes.
httpInspBypassEmpty: 未配置自定义绕过规则
httpInspBypassEmptySubtitle: 内置放行清单始终生效；这里是额外追加的域名后缀
The built-in pass list always applies; these are extra domain suffixes
httpInspCaReadingBody: 正在读取根证书状态，请稍后再试。
The root certificate status is still loading; try again in a moment.

httpInspCaRequiredBody.zh:
HTTPS 检查要把解密后的明文交回应用，必须由系统的根证书信任链认可谛听的根证书。当前是「{problem}」，所以还不能选择目标应用。

去 CA 证书页生成并安装证书？
httpInspCaRequiredBody.en:
HTTPS inspection hands decrypted plain text back to the app, so the system trust chain must accept DITING's root certificate. The current state is "{problem}", so target apps cannot be picked yet.

Open the CA certificate page to generate and install it?

httpInspCaMissing: 尚未生成根证书：前往 CA 证书页生成
No root certificate yet: generate one on the CA certificate page
httpInspCaNotInstalled: 证书已生成但未安装到系统信任存储
The certificate exists but is not in the system trust store
httpInspNeedDomainRulesTitle: Domain rules also need to be on
httpInspNeedDomainRulesBody:
HTTPS 检查负责解密，域名规则负责决定解密后的流量怎么处理。当前域名规则是关闭状态，只开检查不会有任何拦截效果。

是否同时开启域名规则？

HTTPS inspection decrypts traffic and domain rules decide what happens to it. Domain rules are off right now, so inspection alone blocks nothing.

Turn domain rules on as well?
httpInspAppsIntro: Go 隧道接管流量后，HTTPS 流量检查仅检查所选应用的 HTTP(S) 请求，其他应用直接转发。选择应用会取消其「排除应用」「禁止联网」与应用独立规则状态。

Once the Go tunnel takes over traffic, HTTPS inspection only inspects HTTP(S) requests from the selected apps; others are forwarded directly. Selecting an app clears its excluded, blocked and per-app rule state.

httpInspAppsCount.zh: 已选择 {selected} 个应用（可见 {visible}）
